hype_score.label: Hype score
hype_score.description: Fraction of titles using hype lexicon or exclamation marks; higher = more clickbait energy.

listicle_ratio.label: Listicle ratio
listicle_ratio.description: Fraction of titles that start with a number (e.g. '7 things...').

avg_read_time.label: Avg read time (min)
avg_read_time.description: Mean read time across posts. Higher = longer-form content.

summary_length_avg.label: Avg summary length
summary_length_avg.description: Mean character length of the post summary field.

title_length_var.label: Title-length variance
title_length_var.description: Population variance of title length. High = inconsistent style.

tag_entropy.label: Tag entropy
tag_entropy.description: Shannon entropy of the source's tag distribution. High = generalist.

tag_diversity.label: Tag diversity
tag_diversity.description: Unique-tag count divided by post count. High = topic spread.

top_tag_share.label: Top-tag share
top_tag_share.description: Share of posts whose first tag equals the source's most common tag. High = topic-focused.

avg_upvotes.label: Avg upvotes
avg_upvotes.description: Mean number of upvotes per post.

median_upvotes.label: Median upvotes
median_upvotes.description: Median upvotes per post (robust to viral outliers).

avg_comments.label: Avg comments
avg_comments.description: Mean number of comments per post.

zero_engagement_share.label: Zero-engagement share
zero_engagement_share.description: Fraction of posts with both 0 upvotes and 0 comments.

posts_per_week.label: Posts per week
posts_per_week.description: Publishing cadence: posts per 7 days over the observed span.

non_article_ratio.label: Non-article ratio
non_article_ratio.description: Fraction of posts that are not type=article (videos, polls, freeform, etc.).

author_present_share.label: Author present share
author_present_share.description: Fraction of posts where the API exposes an author name (i.e. the source's RSS feed includes <author> metadata). High = bylined feed; low = unbylined. Measures feed metadata, NOT authorship truth — a personal blog with a stripped-down RSS still scores 0.

recency_skew.label: Recency skew
recency_skew.description: Posts in last 90 days / posts older. High = recently active source.
